title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365-Day Firm Trasportation Service Agreement with AlphaGary Corporation.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds the the pricing terms of theAgreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, and Brian Paul Golden. D.T.E. 06-GC-14.
